title: ui2compose: An interpretable pipeline for generating Jetpack Compose code from Android UI screenshots
description: ui2compose converts an Android UI screenshot into compilable Jetpack Compose code. A YOLOv8s detector fine-tuned on a rebalanced 13-class version of the ReDraw dataset localizes the interface components, a rule-based stage links them into a UI graph of containment and alignment relations, and a template-based generator rebuilds a nested Row/Column hierarchy by recursive projection and writes idiomatic Kotlin. Every decision after detection follows an explicit geometric rule, so a wrong grouping can be traced back to the coordinate comparison that produced it. The release includes the trained weights, a Streamlit demo, and the preprocessing and evaluation tooling.
